versions.changelog:
Initial release of forktree — a safe Python CLI wrapper for git worktrees.

- Provides create, list, remove, gc, init, and doctor subcommands with safety pre-flights.
- Enforces strict stdout (data only) and stderr (diagnostics) separation for reliable automation.
- Supports TOML configuration with predictable resolution order and strict mode error handling.
- Outputs machine-friendly formats (TSV, JSON) for agent and CI integration.
- Adds utility exit codes for differentiated error handling.
- Includes support for an optional setup hook and detailed help/diagnostics.
